app.name: Vibrafit
app.tagline: Train at home. Stay consistent. Get stronger.

signup.title: Create account
signup.subtitle: Start training with Vibrafit.
signup.safetyNote: Vibrafit gives training suggestions, not medical advice.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a link to reset your password.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.missingBody: This reset link is missing, invalid, or has already been used. Request a new one to continue.

you.title: You
you.changePasswordSuccess: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
you.dangerZoneBody: Deleting your account permanently removes your profile, equipment, programs and workout history. This can't be undone.
you.deleteConfirmBody: Everything you've logged in Vibrafit — equipment, programs, workouts and sets — is deleted permanently. Enter your password to confirm.

errors.invalid_input: Something's missing from that form. Check the fields and try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.weak_password: That password doesn't meet the requirements below.
errors.email_taken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.invalid_reset_token: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
errors.not_authenticated: You've been signed out. Sign in again to continue.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.invalid_origin: This request was blocked for your safety. Reload the page and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.intro: Enter the gear you own. Vibrafit only ever suggests weights you can actually build.
equipment.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields to save.

errors.invalid_input: Something in the form isn't valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.equipment_too_large: That's more gear than Vibrafit can store. Remove a few items and try again.
errors.generic: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.weight: Enter a weight in kg, like 1.25.
errors.label: Enter a name (1 to {max} characters).
errors.plateTotal: Up to {max} plates in total. You have {total}.

handles.title: Dumbbell handles
handles.hint: Adjustable dumbbells: the bars you slide plates onto.
handles.weightHint: 0 means not weighed yet. Loads then leave out the handle weight.

plates.title: Plates
plates.hint: Loose plates for your handles. Add one row per plate weight.

fixed.title: Fixed weights
fixed.hint: Things that can't change weight: a weight ball, a kettlebell.
fixed.label: Name

bands.title: Bands
bands.hint: Resistance bands. They're tracked for your exercises, not turned into kilograms.
bands.label: Name
bands.resistanceHint: For example light, medium or 15 kg.

loads.title: Loads you can build
loads.empty: Add handles and plates, or a fixed weight, to see what you can build.
loads.pairsHint: Two dumbbells at the same weight. The weight is per hand.
loads.singlesHint: One dumbbell or one fixed weight.
loads.perSideSplit: One with {first} kg per side, the other with {second} kg per side
loads.handlesUnweighed: Your handles aren't weighed yet, so these loads leave out the handle weight.
loads.skippedRows: Some rows are incomplete and aren't counted yet.
loads.error: Couldn't work out your loads. Check the numbers you entered.
